title: Legio XIII vs Bailiffs of Petra
lede:
Legio XIII beat the Bailiffs of Petra 32-14 on Victory Points, crossing the 30 VP target in Battle Round 6.

The two Ironthunder Vanguard squads decided it: they destroyed three Cultist Troopers and two Rapacious Crusader squads in melee, held the 3 VP centre for five rounds running, and the Morale tests their charges forced paid most of COORDINATED SUPPRESSION's 9 VP.
result_line: Legio XIII win 32-14 on Victory Points in Battle Round 6
deployment:
Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). Legio XIII set up along row 12 in front of its HQ at (7,13), weighted to the centre and right: Speculatores at (7,12), Ironthunder Vanguard 2 at (8,12), the Fulminator Squad at (9,12), Ironthunder Vanguard 1 with the Legatus at (10,12) and Legionnaire Squad 1 with the Augur at (11,12). Legionnaire Squad 2 stood alone on the left at (3,12) and the Earthshaker Mortar behind it at (5,13). The Bailiffs of Petra filled row 2 in front of their HQ at (7,1): Rapacious Crusader 2 with the Master of Coin at (5,2) on the left, Rapacious Crusader 3 with the Stygian Actuary at (7,2), Rapacious Crusader 1 with The Chairman of the Chamber at (11,2) on the right, Cultist Troopers 3, 1 and 2 at (4,2), (9,2) and (10,2) and the Forsaken at (3,2). Legio XIII had Priority with fewer units on the battlefield (10 to 11).

The set-up put Legio XIII's two elite melee squads opposite the centre and the Bailiffs' three crusader-and-leader pairs opposite the flanks, with three ten-model Cultist Troopers squads between them: the centre was going to be a melee, the flanks a race the Bailiffs' faster infantry (MOVE 4 with Slave To Cupidity) would win.

1.title: Ironthunder Vanguard 2 takes the centre, the Bailiffs both flanks

feed.text: Primaries revealed: COORDINATED SUPPRESSION for Legio XIII, RAISE THE STANDARD for the Bailiffs, who planted their standard at (0,0), their own back corner. Secondaries kept: COMMAND AUTHORITY and FORWARD PRESENCE. Legio XIII took Tactica Mercurii and spent its 2 CP on Double Time for Legionnaire Squad 1; the Bailiffs banked their 3.

Ironthunder Vanguard 2 advanced to 8,8, inside the centre's Objective Area, with Ironthunder Vanguard 1 and the Legatus at 9,8 and both Legionnaire Squads behind at 8,9 and 7,9. Cultist Troopers 1 reached 6,7 on the other side of the centre; Cultist Troopers 2 and 3 stopped at 8,5 and 6,5. The crusader pairs went wide: Rapacious Crusader 1 with The Chairman to 13,7 and Rapacious Crusader 2 with the Master of Coin to 2,7, one on each flank objective. The Forsaken ran to 4,8.

The Earthshaker Mortar's SWEEP shell put 12 into Cultist Troopers 1 (20 to 8, six models). Speculatores used Auspex Scan and the Stygian Actuary channelled 1 Mana. Every other unit had no legal action.
Legio XIII took the centre on OC 6 vs 4 (3 VP); the Bailiffs held both flanks unopposed (2 + 2). Pietas: Legio XIII +4 (the log line; the round's snapshot still reads 0). 3-4.

2.title: Two Cultist Troopers cut down; Legionnaire Squad 1 shot down on the way in

feed.text: The Bailiffs spent all 6 CP: Double Time on the Master of Coin (2) and Secure Objective on Cultist Troopers 1 (4). Legio XIII put Double Time on Legionnaire Squad 1 again (2). Secondaries kept: OMNIPRESENCE for Legio XIII and TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET for the Bailiffs, for which Legio XIII named the centre. COMMAND AUTHORITY expired.

The Double Time took Legionnaire Squad 1 and the Augur to 11,6, into the Overwatch of The Chairman of the Chamber (4) and Rapacious Crusader 1 (6, and 2 on the Augur): Legionnaire Squad 1 destroyed, the Augur left alone on 2 HP. Ironthunder Vanguard 1 and the Legatus charged Cultist Troopers 1 and 3 from 7,8; Cultist Troopers 1, the unit the 4 CP Secure Objective was on, failed its Fall Back test and broke away to 9,5 (1 damage). Ironthunder Vanguard 2 charged Cultist Troopers 2 at 8,7, after Legionnaire Squad 2's Overwatch had taken 4 off them. The Forsaken charged Speculatores from 3,9, and Rapacious Crusader 3 with the Actuary walked back to 1,1, beside the standard.

Ironthunder Vanguard 2 struck first and put 16 into Cultist Troopers 2; Ironthunder Vanguard 1 then put 20 into Cultist Troopers 3: both destroyed, neither able to strike back. The Forsaken put 5 into Speculatores (6 to 1) and the Mortar took a model off Rapacious Crusader 1 (2). The Chairman's Margin Call on the Legatus and Rapacious Crusader 1's Debt Called Due on the Augur changed nothing. Legionnaire Squad 2 raised Shield Wall, the Augur's Sacrificium gave 2 Mana and the Actuary channelled another.
The centre to Legio XIII on OC 13 vs 0 (3); both flanks to the Bailiffs (2 + 2), and RAISE THE STANDARD paid 1 with Rapacious Crusader 3 and the Actuary beside it. Pietas +2 (6, Tier III). 6-9.

3.title: The Bailiffs walk off the flanks

feed.text: The Bailiffs' Troop Requisition (3 CP) placed a fresh Cultist Troopers at 7,2; Legio XIII's Double Time (2) went on the Fulminator Squad. Both sides kept COORDINATED PUSH.

The Bailiffs had Priority and pulled both crusader pairs off the flanks: Rapacious Crusader 1 with The Chairman from 13,6 to 9,5, Rapacious Crusader 2 with the Master of Coin from 2,7 back to 4,4. Rapacious Crusader 3 and the Actuary walked back from the standard to 4,2, the move the digest marks as undone (3 squares lost). The Fulminator Squad used its Double Time to reach 12,8 and the Augur went to 13,8: the right objective changed hands without a shot. Ironthunder Vanguard 1 charged the new Cultist Troopers at 6,4, and Ironthunder Vanguard 2 charged The Chairman and Rapacious Crusader 1 at 8,6; Rapacious Crusader 1 failed its Morale test and was SUPPRESSED.

Ironthunder Vanguard 1 put 20 into the requisitioned Cultist Troopers: destroyed before they had acted. Ironthunder Vanguard 2 hit seven times through a Debt Called Due and a Margin Call, neither of which changed anything: Rapacious Crusader 1 destroyed (4) and 4 on The Chairman (12 to 8), who had no APt left to strike back. The Forsaken finished Speculatores (destroyed) and took ground to 4,10; Legionnaire Squad 2 put 9 into them (10 to 1). The Augur's Sacrificium added 3 Mana (5). As the Action Phase ended FORWARD PRESENCE completed for the Bailiffs, the Forsaken within 3 squares of Legio XIII's HQ: +3 VP, +1 CP.
Legio XIII held the centre (OC 6 vs 0) and the right (OC 4 vs 0), 5 VP, and COORDINATED SUPPRESSION paid 1 for the SUPPRESSED Chairman. Nobody held the left. Pietas +4 (10, Tier IV). 12-12.

4.title: Legionnaire Squad 2 falls back into the guns

feed.text: Legio XIII switched to Tactica Martis and put Double Time on Legionnaire Squad 2 (2 CP); the Bailiffs put Double Time on the 1-HP Forsaken (3 CP). Both kept MAN OF THE HOUR. Cultist Troopers 1 failed its Morale test and was SUPPRESSED.

Legionnaire Squad 2 fell back from the Forsaken to 2,8, beside the empty left objective. The Forsaken, still next to the Earthshaker Mortar, failed its own Fall Back test and was destroyed by the 1 True Damage of breaking away, its Double Time unused. Ironthunder Vanguard 1 and the Legatus charged Rapacious Crusader 2 and the Master of Coin at 5,5; Rapacious Crusader 2 broke away in disorder (3 damage, a model) to 1,4. The Augur, on 2 HP, charged The Chairman and Cultist Troopers 1 from 13,8 to 10,5, and The Chairman broke away to 9,3 (1 damage). The Mortar's Overwatch took 2 off Rapacious Crusader 3 as it came to 2,5.

Rapacious Crusader 3 shot Legionnaire Squad 2 for 8 (10 to 2) and the Master of Coin finished it with 2: Legionnaire Squad 2 destroyed. The Augur spent 4 Mana on Dies Irae on Cultist Troopers 1 (SAVE -1 and EXPOSED, which no attack used), and Cultist Troopers 1 hit the Augur in melee for 1 (2 to 1). Ironthunder Vanguard 1, whose targets had fallen back, had nothing to hit.

Legio XIII kept the centre (OC 6) and the right (OC 3), 5 VP, and COORDINATED SUPPRESSION paid 2 for The Chairman and Cultist Troopers 1. The Act of Pietas was done, but Legionnaire Squad 2's Fall Back stopped the advance. 19-12.

The Bailiffs' second Troop Requisition (3 CP) placed Cultist Troopers at 7,2 again; Legio XIII spent nothing. Legio XIII kept TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET and the Bailiffs named the left objective (1,7); the Bailiffs kept SECURE THE FLANKS, and their own TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET expired. Cultist Troopers 1 failed Morale on a natural 1.

The new Cultist Troopers charged the Augur from 7,2 to 9,4, and the Augur broke away to 8,7, back on the centre. Ironthunder Vanguard 1 and the Legatus walked onto the centre at 6,7. Rapacious Crusader 2 and the Master of Coin came forward to 3,7 and Rapacious Crusader 3 with the Actuary to 4,8; Ironthunder Vanguard 2 charged those two from 8,6 to 5,7 and Rapacious Crusader 3 failed Morale (SUPPRESSED). The Chairman went back to 8,1.

The Master of Coin's Called To Account marked Ironthunder Vanguard 1 for rerolls that no attack used. Ironthunder Vanguard 2 hit six times: Rapacious Crusader 3 destroyed (4) and 4 on the Stygian Actuary (6 to 2) after both its Feel No Pain rolls failed. Margin Call and Debt Called Due again changed nothing, and the Mortar took a model off Rapacious Crusader 2 (1). The Actuary spent the Bailiffs' 2 Mana on Gaze of the Abyss on Ironthunder Vanguard 2 (MS -1, BS -1), which bought nothing.
The centre (OC 8) and the right (OC 3) to Legio XIII, 5 VP, and COORDINATED SUPPRESSION paid its 3 VP cap for The Chairman, the Actuary and Cultist Troopers 1. 27-12.

6.title: COORDINATED SUPPRESSION carries Legio XIII past 30

feed.text: The Bailiffs kept OMNIPRESENCE and spent 4 CP: Double Time on The Chairman (2) and a Rally Cry through the Master of Coin for Rapacious Crusader 2 (2). Legio XIII's Legatus called a Rally Cry for the Augur (2). Legio XIII's OMNIPRESENCE and both COORDINATED PUSH cards expired. The Stygian Actuary failed Morale.

Ironthunder Vanguard 2 fell back from the Stygian Actuary, which has no melee weapon, to 5,5. Ironthunder Vanguard 1 and the Legatus charged Rapacious Crusader 2, the Master of Coin and the Actuary, leaving the centre for 4,7; Rapacious Crusader 2 failed Morale on a natural 1, then all three broke away in disorder: Rapacious Crusader 2 destroyed (2), the Master of Coin to 2,10 (3) and the Actuary to 3,9 (1). The Augur moved to 7,6, the only Legio XIII unit left on the centre. Cultist Troopers 1 came to 9,7, losing 1 to the Fulminator Squad's Overwatch, and the new Cultist Troopers to 9,6.
The Mortar's SWEEP put 6 into the new Cultist Troopers (20 to 14). Cultist Troopers 1 then shot the Augur through a 1 CP Go to Ground: Augur destroyed, and the centre went to nobody.

Legio XIII scored only the right (OC 3), 2 VP, and COORDINATED SUPPRESSION paid 3 more for The Chairman, the Master of Coin and the Actuary: 32, over the 30 VP target. SECURE THE FLANKS paid the Bailiffs 2 for the Master of Coin at 2,10. 32-14, Legio XIII win.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

Legio XIII scored 23 objective VP, 15 from the centre in Rounds 1 to 5 and 8 from the right flank in Rounds 3 to 6, and 9 from COORDINATED SUPPRESSION (0, 0, 1, 2, 3, 3 by round). It completed no secondary. The Bailiffs of Petra scored 8 objective VP, all from the two flanks in Rounds 1 and 2, 1 from RAISE THE STANDARD in Round 2, 3 from FORWARD PRESENCE and 2 from SECURE THE FLANKS. They led 9-6 after two rounds; from Round 3 on they scored 5 VP, all from secondaries.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

Ironthunder Vanguard 2 (35 RP) was the battle: 32 damage, three kills (Cultist Troopers 2, Rapacious Crusader 1, Rapacious Crusader 3) and 10.0 VP, 9 of them hinged on it, holding the centre alone in Rounds 1, 3 and 4. Ironthunder Vanguard 1 with the Legatus did 40 damage and destroyed two 20-HP Cultist Troopers, each in a single Action Phase. The Earthshaker Mortar added 23, 12 of it with the opening SWEEP on Cultist Troopers 1. The Fulminator Squad (20 RP) never spent an APt (inaction 5.75) and did 1 damage, yet scored 7.0 VP with 6 hinged on it: it walked onto the empty right flank in Round 3 and stood there to the end. That is holding ground, not idling.

COORDINATED SUPPRESSION's 9 VP is unassigned in the scoring record, but the log shows where the SUPPRESSED units came from: Rapacious Crusader 1 failed Morale when Ironthunder Vanguard 2 charged it in Round 3 and The Chairman of the Chamber stayed SUPPRESSED after the squad died; Rapacious Crusader 3 failed against Ironthunder Vanguard 2's charge in Round 5, leaving the Stygian Actuary SUPPRESSED; Rapacious Crusader 2 failed against Ironthunder Vanguard 1's in Round 6, leaving the Master of Coin; Cultist Troopers 1 failed in the Command Phase of Rounds 4 and 5 after the Mortar's 12.

For the Bailiffs, the 7 RP Forsaken were the best buy: they killed Speculatores and scored FORWARD PRESENCE (3.0 VP, 42.9 per 100 RP). The Master of Coin scored 4.0 (a flank and SECURE THE FLANKS). The Chairman of the Chamber (70 RP) did 4 damage, all with one Overwatch shot in Round 2. Three of the Bailiffs' five Cultist Troopers (two starting squads and the first requisition) were destroyed in Vanguard melee without dealing a point of damage. Over the battle Legio XIII dealt 121 damage to 30 and destroyed seven units (127 RP, one of them a requisitioned Cultist Troopers) for four (75 RP).

{{chart:attrition}}

What the Bailiffs could not do

  • Hold ground and fight. Their flank OC was the crusader-and-leader pairs. When those pairs left in Round 3 to fight, the flanks emptied and the Bailiffs never scored an objective again.
  • TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET asked them to control the centre, which Legio XIII held with the Vanguard; every unit that went near it was destroyed. It expired in Round 5.
  • COORDINATED PUSH (four units closer to the enemy HQ in one Movement Phase) expired in Round 6, while their crusaders were moving back and sideways. MAN OF THE HOUR needed one unit to destroy two; the Master of Coin (Legionnaire Squad 2) and Cultist Troopers 1 (the Augur) got one each. OMNIPRESENCE was kept in Round 6 with no objective held.
  • RAISE THE STANDARD was planted at (0,0), the Bailiffs' back corner. It pays 2 VP only in the enemy half; here it paid 1, once, when Rapacious Crusader 3 and the Actuary walked there in Round 2 and back out in Round 3.

Legio XIII's secondaries all failed too: COMMAND AUTHORITY needed an HQ Command on a unit in the enemy half, and its Double Times went to units in its own half; OMNIPRESENCE and its TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET both needed the left objective, which no Legio XIII unit reached after Legionnaire Squad 2 died there; COORDINATED PUSH expired; MAN OF THE HOUR, kept in Round 4, saw one credited kill, Ironthunder Vanguard 2's on Rapacious Crusader 3 (Rapacious Crusader 2's death in its Fall Back is credited to nobody).

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The AI, not the army

  • Round 2, Legionnaire Squad 1: Legio XIII's AI spent Double Time to move it 8,9 to 11,6, into Overwatch from The Chairman and Rapacious Crusader 1. It died in the Movement Phase. The record says the command paid off because the move needed it; the move was the mistake.
  • Round 2, Secure Objective: the Bailiffs paid 4 CP for +1 OC on Cultist Troopers 1, which then fell back off the centre when Ironthunder Vanguard 1 charged. It bought nothing.
  • Round 3, the flanks: both crusader pairs walked off the flank objectives they had scored 4 VP a round on (13,6 to 9,5 and 2,7 to 4,4). Rapacious Crusader 1 and its Chairman were charged at 9,5 and Rapacious Crusader 1 died; the Fulminator Squad took the right flank unopposed for 8 VP over four rounds.
  • Margin Call, three times: its -X AR/FR counts friendly GREED units holding Gold, and the log shows no Gold until Round 6 (Cultist Troopers 1 Gold 0 -> 1). Every Margin Call was X = 0 and changed nothing, the Chairman's action in Rounds 2, 3 and 5. The Bailiffs' other debuffs, Debt Called Due (three uses), Called To Account and Gaze of the Abyss, also bought nothing.
  • Round 4, the Forsaken: 3 CP of Double Time on a 1-HP unit, which then failed its Fall Back test and died.
  • Round 4, Legionnaire Squad 2: it fell back from that same 1-HP Forsaken, which the Fall Back record shows it was expected to kill, to 2,8 in the open, where Rapacious Crusader 3 and the Master of Coin shot it dead (8 and 2). The Fall Back also stopped Pietas advancing.
  • Round 6, the centre: Ironthunder Vanguard 1 charged off it and Ironthunder Vanguard 2 fell back from an Actuary with no melee weapon, leaving the 1-HP Augur alone there to be shot. That gave up 3 VP; Legio XIII crossed 30 anyway.
  • The Fall Back record is inflated by the AI's charge-planning probes: Rapacious Crusader 1's Round 3 'caught by others' (its engager the Augur, never adjacent), Ironthunder Vanguard 1's Round 5 'held' and the requisitioned Cultist Troopers' Round 6 'risky hold' (danger 25.28) had no enemy adjacent when they were logged.

The result looks like the army first: nothing in the Bailiffs' list could stand in front of an Ironthunder Vanguard, and their abilities did not change one attack. The Bailiffs' AI made it a rout by giving up the flanks in Round 3, the only VP its army was earning.

closing: Two Ironthunder Vanguard squads took five units off the board, held the centre for five rounds and broke the Morale that paid Legio XIII's Primary. The Bailiffs led 9-6 on their flanks after two rounds, walked off them in Round 3, and scored only secondaries after that.
